fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The partition error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The partition error message, which may be null if no additional details are available.

fields.name: ActiveProducers
fields.about: The active producers for the partition.

fields.name: LastSequence
fields.about: The last sequence number sent by the producer.

fields.name: LastTimestamp
fields.about: The last timestamp sent by the producer.

fields.name: CoordinatorEpoch
fields.about: The current epoch of the producer group.

fields.name: CurrentTxnStartOffset
fields.about: The current transaction start offset of the producer.
